title: Unescaped output rendering (XSS)

patterns.message: React dangerouslySetInnerHTML renders unescaped HTML — if it carries model/user output this is XSS.
Vue v-html renders unescaped HTML (XSS risk for model/user output).
Django mark_safe() disables escaping — XSS if the value is model/user-derived.
Flask render_template_string() on dynamic input is SSTI/XSS-prone.
Template autoescape disabled — output is not HTML-escaped.

remediation: Context-encode model/user output; keep template autoescaping on; never mark LLM output safe.
